race.comment: RIVERBEND GOLD (2) charged home to win a Class 1 over the mile at Corowa two back, a race that has thrown up three subsequent winners. Had a 53-day let-up before an eye-catching fifth over 1400m here last time. Needed that latest hit-out and looks the one to beat back to his pet distance. ROSCOMAIN BILL (5) started favourite and created a great impression on debut last time out over 1400m at this track, coming from near the tail to salute by a widening 1.6 lengths. Should relish the extra 200m and looks to have the class to take this next step. RIVERBEND UNICORN (9) settled handy but lacked the turn of foot required to lodge a serious threat at his latest run over 1300m at Corowa. In the money twice over today's journey so this looks a nice race for him. SPLENDID MAGNUS (8) won a hot form race over this trip at Nowra two back. In contention if she recaptures that form. Last start Wagga winner DUNWITHYA (4) has been racing well for some time and must be considered.
